incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-12345 — KV cache eviction rate spiked for service=runtime-gen, p95 latency > 800ms, errors increased on /v1/generate. Docs: https://pagerduty/INC-12345

maria: Acked. I'm oncall, looking. Can everyone hold on non-essential deploys?

ash: copy — pausing canary. Maria, can you paste the eviction/HR metrics?

maria: pulling metrics now. initial snapshot: total_evictions=1.2M in 10m, global_hit_rate=12% (was ~86% earlier), p95=820ms, token-errors up 4x. Seems like huge cache thrashing.

maria: query I ran (datadog):
```
avg(last_10m):sum:kv_cache.evictions{env:prod} by {cache_group} 
avg(last_10m):avg:kv_cache.hit_rate{env:prod} by {cache_group}
```

devon: noted. Could be a bad model rollout or suddenly cold prefixes. Any recent model pushes?

ash: no model pushes in last 12h, config/policy unchanged. We did have an increase in prefix diversity from one customer (acct: ACME) after batch migration.

kevin: also seeing eviction spikes correlated with a sharp increase in short-lived keys (per-request KV tags). That will trash LRU quickly.

maria: mitigation idea — temporarily increase cache max_entries & disable aggressive eviction on the hot pool to let working set warm back up. I'll try a conservative bump and watch.

ash: +1. If we can avoid a full restart that'd be best. There's a runtime config flag.

maria: applying:
```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/inference-runtime CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=200000
# rolling restart avoided by dynamic config
```

incident-bot: Change submitted: config-update-9876 by maria — see https://deploys/9876

maria: immediate observation: evictions_rate dropping, hit_rate climbing. p95 down to ~220ms after 80s. still watching for secondary spikes.

kevin: good. I'm also enabling per-customer eviction tagging to help isolate noisy tenants. will push flag to emit tag=acct_id for eviction metrics.

devon: I'm temporarily scaling the cache pool (node count +1) to give extra headroom while we stabilize.

sre-bot: autoscaler: scaled cache-pool-prod from 4 -> 5 nodes (initiated by devon).

maria: after 5m: global_hit_rate=68%, evictions falling to baseline. Traffic to /v1/generate errors back to normal. Looks mitigated.

lydia: great work. Post-incident: we should tune the eviction alert — it fired for transient blips and created noise. Proposals:
- only alert if evictions > 500/min sustained for 3m AND hit_rate < 30%
- rollup to 5m to avoid flapping
- add a separate low-priority alert for any sudden increase in prefix diversity (new metric)

ash: agree. Also need a dashboard that shows per-cache-group hit-rate, per-account eviction rates, and a histogram of key TTLs / sizes.

maria: I'll open the follow-up ticket for cleanup/action items. Will include recommended thresholds, dashboard links, and runbook edits.

maria: creating ticket RD-3210: "KV cache: eviction alert tuning + per-tenant eviction dashboard" — https://jira/REDWOOD/RD-3210

ash: sample Datadog monitor (proposal):
```json
{
  "name": "KV cache eviction - prod (severity: P1 if sustained)",
  "query": "avg(last_5m):sum:kv_cache.evictions{env:prod} by {cache_group} > 1500 AND avg(last_5m):avg:kv_cache.hit_rate{env:prod} < 0.30",
  "evaluation_delay": 120,
  "notification": "PagerDuty:incidents@redwood.com",
  "no_data_timeframe": 10
}
```

kevin: also propose we add a trigger guard that ignores eviction alerts during config / rollout windows (deploys flagged), or at least annotates them so oncall knows it's expected.

lydia: yes, add deploy tags to metric events. Also we should change the alert noise SLO: keep eviction alerts suppressed unless impact on p95 or error rate is observed.

maria: runbook edits I'm adding to RD-3210:
- quick mitigation steps (increase CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES, scale cache nodes)
- rollback checks (how to revert config)
- where to look: per-tenant eviction graph, prefix diversity metric, recent deploys list

devon: I'll own the per-tenant dashboard creation — will add heatmap of eviction rate by acct_id + time slider.

ash: small follow-up: can we add a metric that measures 'effective working set size' (approx unique keys in last 30m)? would help detect when diversity explodes.

kevin: yes, can emit an approximate cardinality sketch to datadog; I'll prototype.

maria: current status: mitigated, monitoring stable. handing off to @oncall-2 for the overnight watch and RD-3210 follow-ups.

oncall-2: acked. I'll keep eyes on the new dashboards, and will escalate immediately if evictions bounce back or p95 > 400ms.

maria: thanks everyone — great cross-team response. Postmortem will be done after RD-3210 actions, and we'll include a short FAQ for customers impacted.

lydia: one last note — notify support to reach out to any customers who saw increased error rates (ACME flagged). I'll draft a customer note. :thumbsup:

maria: draft support note link: https://docs.internal/incident-notes/INC-12345-draft

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "Monitoring" at 1964501370 — no active page.

maria: thread closing soon; if anything new appears ping me directly.

oncall-2: will update RD-3210 with dashboard link once created and set a follow-up meeting.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem meeting in 48h (calendar invite RD-3210-POC).
